quote: We reframe semantic parsing towards multiple formalisms and from multiple languages as multilingual machine translation

Being able to associate natural language text with well-defined and machine-actionable meaning representations, i.e. the task of semantic parsing (SP), is one of the holy grails in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Understanding.
datasets: UCCA portion of the training data
outputs: linearized graph representations of meaning (e.g., AMR and UCCA graphs)

quote: We evaluate AMR and cross-lingual AMR parsing by using the Smatch score
We evaluate AMR and cross‑lingual AMR parsing by using the Smatch score, a metric that computes the overlap between two graphs.
